gt_summary: Log-linear gravity with bilinear size-complementarity interaction: ln X = beta_0 + a*ln Y_i + b*ln Y_n + kappa*(ln Y_i * ln Y_n) + beta_dist*ln dist + binary trade-cost terms
submission_summary: Standard separable log-linear gravity: ln X = const + 1*ln Y_i + 1*ln Y_n - 1*ln dist + binary trade-cost terms (unit elasticities, no interaction)
matched: Correct functional family: log-linear gravity model
Correct signs on all terms (positive GDP, negative distance, positive binary dummies)
Binary dummy coefficients in reasonable range
missed: Missing kappa*(ln Y_i * ln Y_n) bilinear size-complementarity interaction term — the key GT distinguishing feature
GDP elasticities fixed at 1.0 instead of fitted (GT: a=0.83, b=0.54)
Distance elasticity fixed at -1.0 instead of GT -1.14
coefficient_assessment: Signs all correct. Magnitudes approximate but not fitted. Unit elasticities on GDPs vs GT's asymmetric ~0.83/0.54. Main structural gap is the missing interaction term, not coefficient scale.
